simple.meaning: תְּנוּאָה (tᵉnûwʼâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “alienation ; by implication, enmity.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: תְּנוּאָה (H8569) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 14:34, with occurrences in Numbers, Job.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תְּנוּאָה (H8569) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in תְּנוּאָה (H8569) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: תְּנוּאָה (tᵉnûwʼâh) / H8569 is traced through Numbers 14:34, Job 33:10 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H8569. tenuah [ תְּנוּאָה ] noun feminine opposition ; — suffix תְּנוּאָתִיּ Num 14:34 my opposition , of ׳י ; plural יִמְצָא עָלַי תְּנוּאוֺת Job 33:10 = occasions, for hostility (|| count as enemy).

occurrences.englishText: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.’
Behold, he finds occasions against me.
